title: MariaDB Instance Parameters
description: Parameters for provisioning a MariaDB database instance

clusterTarget.description: Target cluster name — must match an existing cluster in Sovereign Core

auth.database.description: Name of the database to create on first run

auth.username.description: Name of the application user to create alongside the database

auth.existingSecret.description: Name of a pre-existing Secret containing MariaDB credentials. Required keys: 'mariadb-root-password', 'mariadb-password', 'mariadb-replication-password' (replication only). When set, auth.rootPassword and auth.password are ignored.

primary.resourcesPreset.description: Resource preset for primary pods (nano, micro, small, medium, large, xlarge, 2xlarge)

primary.persistence.enabled.description: Enable persistent storage for the primary

primary.persistence.size.description: PVC size for the primary (Kubernetes quantity, e.g. 8Gi)

primary.persistence.storageClass.description: StorageClass for the primary PVC; leave empty to use the cluster default

secondary.replicaCount.description: Number of secondary (read replica) pods; only used when architecture=replication

secondary.resourcesPreset.description: Resource preset for secondary pods (nano, micro, small, medium, large, xlarge, 2xlarge)

secondary.persistence.size.description: PVC size for secondary pods (Kubernetes quantity, e.g. 8Gi)

secondary.persistence.storageClass.description: StorageClass for secondary PVCs; leave empty to use the cluster default

global.imageRegistry.description: Override the image registry for all images; set to the internal Quay hostname when air-gapped

global.defaultStorageClass.description: Default StorageClass applied to all PVCs; overrides cluster default
